note: Per-tool four-level acceptance ledger. One row per model-visible tool name claimed by a family in packages/tools/families/manifest.json (claims read with the plane DEFAULT names: readName=read, names={grep:team_grep,glob:team_glob,bash:team_bash}) plus the named-bridge jobs trio (packages/runtime/src/plugin/live/jobs-family-bridge.mjs JOBS_MANAGEMENT_NAMES). Levels: L1-definition (the family C1 suite exists, is in the root vitest population the ci-full census grades, and names the tool), L2-mounted (live Host mount, tool on the placement feed), L3-refusal (live typed refusal with zero effect), L4-positive (live authorized call whose real effect was read back). Status PROVEN | DISCLOSED | NOT_VERIFIED. PROVEN L1 carries evidence {suite}; PROVEN L2-L4 carry evidence {record, case} naming a committed u5-run-record/1 RUN record whose case verdict is PASS. A PROVEN L2-L4 may opt into proof:'CASE' (with runOverall/failedScope/caseIndependence disclosure) to cite a record whose overall is not PASS; otherwise the default RUN proof requires record.overall==='PASS', a real-host binding (bindings.hostSha), and no mock/offline marker (and, under --candidate-sha, bindings.teamSha equal to it). DISCLOSED carries reason (verbatim from source) + pr (+ source, checked to contain the reason). Checked by scripts/eb3-tool-acceptance.mjs (ci-integration). Honesty is the merge gate; completeness (every L4 PROVEN) is the G5 release gate, not a CI colour.
